purpose: Fresh complete comparison after general mallocng framing and page-table teardown optimization; all owned builds and correctness guests must finish first.
selection: Every complete run in this fixed four-capture campaign participates, with all raw samples and outliers; failures are preserved separately, not converted into results.
comparison: All six workload medians must be no slower in both individual cohorts and when all 14 samples per guest are pooled.
limitations: Other sessions continue running on the shared host. All owned compilation and correctness guests will finish before timing. Recorded timings describe QEMU TCG, not native hardware.
status: Declared before final v5 artifacts and timings; pending implementation and regression completion.
